exports.name="huwiki-slideshow-exports";exports.platforms=["browser"];exports.after=["startup"];exports.synchronous=true;
exports.startup=function(){
 var W=$tw.wiki,base="$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/vendor/";
 function basename(s){return String(s||"HUWiki").replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|\x00-\x1f]/g,"-").slice(0,90)||"HUWiki";}
 function wikiList(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return v.slice();return String(v||"").match(/\[\[[^\]]+\]\]|[^\s]+/g)||[];}
 function wikiListTitle(v){return String(v||"").replace(/^\[\[|\]\]$/g,"");}
 function pluginDependencies(rows){var present={},wanted={};rows.forEach(function(row){if(row&&row["plugin-type"])present[String(row.title||"")]=true;});rows.forEach(function(row){if(!row)return;if(row["plugin-type"])wikiList(row.dependents).forEach(function(title){title=wikiListTitle(title);if(title)wanted[title]=true;});var tags=wikiList(row.tags).map(wikiListTitle),text=String(row.text||"");if(tags.indexOf("pasteup")>=0||text.indexOf("$:/plugins/huwiki/pasteup/")>=0)wanted["$:/plugins/huwiki/pasteup"]=true;if(tags.indexOf("HUWiki-Præsentation")>=0)wanted["$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow"]=true;});return Object.keys(wanted).filter(function(title){return !present[title];});}
 function assertDependencies(rows){const missing=pluginDependencies(rows).filter(t=>!W.getTiddler(t));if(missing.length)throw Error(ui.t('Installér først de manglende afhængigheder: ')+missing.join(', '));}
 function downloadBlob(blob,name){const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=url;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),30000);}
 function embeddedOnly(rows){const unresolved=[];rows.forEach(t=>{if(t['plugin-type']||t.title.startsWith('$:/'))return;if(t._canonical_uri&&!/^data:/.test(t._canonical_uri)||/<(?:iframe|img|video|audio|source)\b[^>]*\bsrc\s*=\s*["'](?:https?:|file:)/i.test(t.text||'')||/\[img\[[^\]]*https?:\/\//i.test(t.text||''))unresolved.push(t.title);});if(unresolved.length)throw Error(ui.t('Indlejr først eksterne medier i disse tiddlere: ')+Array.from(new Set(unresolved)).join(', '));}
 async function backup(report){
  await window.HUWikiSlideshowVendors.ensure(['jszip.js']);report(ui.t('Samler den lokale wiki…'));
  const rows=[];W.each(t=>{if(!/^\$:\/(?:temp|state)\//.test(t.fields.title)&&t.fields.title!=='$:/HistoryList')rows.push(t.getFieldStrings());});
  assertDependencies(rows);embeddedOnly(rows);
  const wiki=new $tw.Wiki();wiki.addTiddlers(rows);wiki.readPluginInfo();wiki.registerPluginTiddlers('plugin');wiki.unpackPluginTiddlers();
  wiki.addTiddler({title:'$:/config/SaveWikiButton/Template',text:'$:/core/save/all'});
  const html=wiki.renderTiddler('text/plain','$:/core/save/all',{variables:{wikiTitle:W.getTiddlerText('$:/SiteTitle','HUWiki'),publishFilter:''}});
  if(!html.includes('$:/boot/boot.js'))throw Error(ui.t('Den selvstændige wiki kunne ikke dannes.'));
  const Zip=require(base+'jszip.js'),zip=new Zip();zip.file('index.html',html);zip.file('HUWiki-backup/tiddlers.json',JSON.stringify(rows,null,2));
  zip.file('HUWiki-backup/manifest.json',JSON.stringify({format:'huwiki-portable-backup',schemaVersion:2,title:W.getTiddlerText('$:/SiteTitle'),files:[],createdAt:new Date().toISOString()}));
  zip.file('README.txt','HUWiki Slideshow — local editable backup. Unzip and open index.html. Edit normally and save with TiddlyWiki. All embedded data and original plugin licenses are included.');
  report('Pakker ZIP…');downloadBlob(await zip.generateAsync({type:'blob',compression:'DEFLATE'}),basename(W.getTiddlerText('$:/SiteTitle'))+'-HUWiki-backup.zip');
 }
 async function pdf(deck,render,report){
   report(ui.t("Indlæser PDF-værktøj…"));await window.HUWikiSlideshowVendors.ensure(["html2canvas.js","jspdf.js"]);
   var html2canvas=require(base+"html2canvas.js"),jsPDF=require(base+"jspdf.js").jsPDF;
   var pdf=new jsPDF({orientation:"landscape",unit:"pt",format:[960,540],compress:true});
   var stage=document.createElement("div");stage.className="huws-stage huws-pdf-capture";stage.setAttribute("data-theme",deck.theme);
   stage.style.cssText="position:fixed;inset:auto;left:-20000px;top:0;width:1600px;height:900px;right:auto;bottom:auto;display:block;overflow:hidden;z-index:-1";
   var content=document.createElement("div");content.className="huws-stage-content";content.style.cssText="width:1600px;height:900px;max-width:none;padding:70px;overflow:hidden;font-size:40px";stage.appendChild(content);document.body.appendChild(stage);
   try{for(var i=0;i<deck.slides.length;i++){
     report("Danner PDF-side "+(i+1)+ui.t(" af ")+deck.slides.length+"…");var slide=render(deck.slides[i],deck);
     content.innerHTML=slide.html;content.classList.toggle("huws-stage-pasteup",slide.visual);content.classList.toggle("huws-stage-composed",slide.composed);content.style.padding=slide.visual?"0":"70px";
     if(content.querySelector("iframe,video,audio,canvas"))throw Error("Slide "+(i+1)+ui.t(" indeholder levende medier. Erstat dem med et billede til PDF-eksport."));
     await document.fonts.ready;
     await Promise.all(Array.from(content.querySelectorAll("img")).map(async function(img){
       if(!img.complete)await new Promise(function(resolve,reject){var timer=setTimeout(function(){reject(Error(ui.t("Et billede kunne ikke indlæses.")));},15000);img.onload=function(){clearTimeout(timer);resolve();};img.onerror=function(){clearTimeout(timer);reject(Error(ui.t("Et billede kunne ikke indlæses.")));};});
       if(!img.naturalWidth)throw Error(ui.t("Et billede mangler på slide ")+(i+1));
       if(/^https?:/.test(img.src)&&new URL(img.src).origin!==location.origin){
         // Read pixels first: otherwise html2canvas silently drops CORS-blocked images.
         var response=await fetch(img.src,{mode:"cors"});if(!response.ok)throw Error(ui.t("Et billede kan ikke læses til PDF."));
         var blob=await response.blob();img.src=await new Promise(function(resolve,reject){var r=new FileReader();r.onload=function(){resolve(r.result);};r.onerror=reject;r.readAsDataURL(blob);});await img.decode();
       }
       // Bake object-fit and SVG into pixels; html2canvas does not preserve object-fit.
       var fit=getComputedStyle(img).objectFit,rect=img.getBoundingClientRect();
       if(rect.width>0&&rect.height>0&&(fit==='contain'||fit==='cover'||/^data:image\/svg\+xml/.test(img.src))){
         var raster=document.createElement('canvas');raster.width=Math.ceil(rect.width);raster.height=Math.ceil(rect.height);
         var iw=img.naturalWidth,ih=img.naturalHeight,ratio=fit==='cover'?Math.max(raster.width/iw,raster.height/ih):Math.min(raster.width/iw,raster.height/ih);
         var dw=fit==='fill'?raster.width:iw*ratio,dh=fit==='fill'?raster.height:ih*ratio;
         raster.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,(raster.width-dw)/2,(raster.height-dh)/2,dw,dh);
         img.style.width=rect.width+'px';img.style.height=rect.height+'px';img.style.objectFit='fill';img.src=raster.toDataURL('image/png');await img.decode();
       }
     }));
     if(content.scrollHeight>content.clientHeight+2||content.scrollWidth>content.clientWidth+2)throw Error("Slide "+(i+1)+ui.t(" er større end PDF-siden. Forkort indholdet eller brug PasteUp-layout."));
     var canvas=await html2canvas(stage,{scale:1,backgroundColor:null,logging:false,useCORS:true,width:1600,height:900,windowWidth:1600,windowHeight:900});
     if(i)pdf.addPage([960,540],"landscape");pdf.addImage(canvas.toDataURL("image/jpeg",0.92),"JPEG",0,0,960,540);canvas.width=canvas.height=0;
   }
   var blob=pdf.output('blob');if(blob.size>20*1024*1024)throw Error(ui.t('PDF er for stor. Del præsentationen op.'));
   var filename=basename(deck.name)+'.pdf';downloadBlob(blob,filename);return {downloaded:true,name:filename};
   }finally{stage.remove();}
 }
 async function portablePackage(pack,report){
  const result=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(pack));
  for(const row of result.data.tiddlers){
   const uri=String(row._canonical_uri||'');
   if(!uri){if((row['av-file-id']||row['source-file-id'])&&!row.text)throw Error(ui.t('Indlejr først mediefilen: ')+row.title);delete row['av-file-id'];delete row['source-file-id'];delete row['av-url'];continue;}
   if(!/^data:(image|audio|video)\/|^data:application\/pdf/.test(uri))throw Error(ui.t('Indlejr først mediefilen: ')+row.title);
   delete row['av-file-id'];delete row['source-file-id'];delete row['av-url'];
  }
  embeddedOnly(result.data.tiddlers);
  if(JSON.stringify(result.data).length>20*1024*1024)throw Error(ui.t('Pakken overstiger 20 MB. Brug komplet ZIP-backup.'));return result;
 }

 window.HUWikiSlideshowExports={backup:backup,pdf:pdf,portablePackage:portablePackage};
};

   report(ui.t('Læser side ')+n+ui.t(' af ')+pdfDocument.numPages+'…');const page=await pdfDocument.getPage(n);
   const text=await page.getTextContent();let plain='';text.items.forEach(x=>{plain+=String(x.str||'')+(x.hasEOL?'\n':' ');});plain=plain.trim();
   const viewport=page.getViewport({scale:1}),ratio=viewport.width/viewport.height;if(!Number.isFinite(ratio)||viewport.width<=0||viewport.height<=0)throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldigt sideformat.'));

 function validateBundle(data){

  if(data.deck.slides.length<1||data.deck.slides.length>150||data.tiddlers.length>1500)throw Error(ui.t('Præsentationen er tom eller for stor.'));
  const seen=new Set();

   if(!t||typeof t.title!=='string'||!t.title||t.title.startsWith('$:/')||t.title.length>230||seen.has(t.title))throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldig eller gentaget tiddlertitel i importfilen.'));seen.add(t.title);
   if(t['module-type']||t['plugin-type']||t.type==='application/javascript'||(Array.isArray(t.tags)?t.tags:$tw.utils.parseStringArray(t.tags||'')).some(tag=>tag.startsWith('$:/tags/')))throw Error(ui.t('Importfilen må ikke installere kode eller plugins.'));
   if((t._canonical_uri&&!/^data:(image|audio|video)\/|^data:application\/pdf/.test(t._canonical_uri))||t['av-file-id']||t['source-file-id'])throw Error(ui.t('Importfilen har eksterne filreferencer. Brug komplet ZIP-backup eller indlejrede billeder.'));
   if(t.text!=null&&typeof t.text!=='string')throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldigt tiddlerindhold.'));
  });
  data.deck.slides.forEach(s=>{if(!s||!seen.has(s.title))throw Error(ui.t('En slide mangler sit indhold i importfilen.'));});
  const packageWiki=new $tw.Wiki();data.tiddlers.forEach(t=>packageWiki.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(t)));const activeRefs=d=>window.HUWikiSlideshowPackage.references(d,packageWiki).map(r=>r.target);
  activeRefs(data.deck).forEach(t=>{if(!seen.has(t)&&! /^(https?:|data:|blob:|#)/i.test(t))throw Error(ui.t('Importfilen mangler aktivt indhold: ')+t);});
  if(data.entryTitle){if(!seen.has(data.entryTitle))throw Error(ui.t('Pakken mangler startpræsentationen.'));const byTitle=new Map(data.tiddlers.map(t=>[t.title,t]));data.tiddlers.filter(t=>(Array.isArray(t.tags)?t.tags:$tw.utils.parseStringArray(t.tags||'')).includes('HUWiki-Præsentation')).forEach(t=>{let d;try{d=JSON.parse(t.text);}catch(e){throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldig målpræsentation: ')+t.title);}if(!Array.isArray(d.slides)||d.slides.some(s=>!seen.has(s.title)))throw Error(ui.t('Målpræsentationen mangler slides: ')+t.title);activeRefs(d).filter(x=>! /^(https?:|data:|blob:|#)/i.test(x)).forEach(x=>{if(!seen.has(x))throw Error(ui.t('Målpræsentationen mangler indhold: ')+x);});});}

  return data;

 function slideEditor(host,slide,deck,api){const b=bindings(slide),board=slide.layoutPasteUp||deck.defaultLayoutPasteUp||'';host.innerHTML=ui.t('<h4>Levende indhold</h4><div class="huwl-binding-grid">')+[['titleField',ui.t('Felt til overskrift')],['bodyField',ui.t('Felt til indhold')],['imageTitle','Billedtiddler (valgfri)'],['imageField',ui.t('Ellers billedfelt på kilden')],['secondaryTitle',ui.t('Anden tiddler (to kolonner)')],['footer',ui.t('Bundtekst (ellers præsentationens navn)')]].map(([k,label])=>'<label>'+label+'<input data-binding="'+k+'" value="'+esc(b[k])+'"'+(['imageTitle','secondaryTitle'].includes(k)?' list="huwl-tiddlers"':'')+'></label>').join('')+'</div><datalist id="huwl-tiddlers">'+api.titles().map(t=>'<option value="'+esc(t)+'"></option>').join('')+ui.t('</datalist><div class="huws-inline-actions"><button type="button" id="huwl-clone">Lav egen variant i PasteUp</button><button type="button" id="huwl-preview">Forhåndsvis layout</button></div><p class="huws-hint">Forhåndsvisningen er statisk.   let ownedBoard='';function personal(){if(!ownedBoard){slide.layoutPasteUp=clone(slide.layoutPasteUp||board,slide.title,bindings(slide));ownedBoard=slide.layoutPasteUp;slide.displayMode='layout';api.changed();}return slide.layoutPasteUp;}

  const deckSelect=host.querySelector('#huwl-action-deck');W.each(t=>{if((t.fields.tags||[]).includes('HUWiki-Præsentation')&&t.fields.title!==api.deckTitle){const o=document.createElement('option');o.value=t.fields.title;o.textContent=t.fields.title;deckSelect.appendChild(o);}});deckSelect.onchange=()=>{try{actionTargets();}catch(e){status.textContent=e.message;}};host.querySelector('#huwl-action').onchange=actionTargets;

  host.querySelector('#huwl-action-save').onclick=()=>{try{const field=host.querySelector('#huwl-field').value,kind=host.querySelector('#huwl-action').value,target=host.querySelector('#huwl-target').value.trim()||field,color=host.querySelector('#huwl-color').value;if(!fields.includes(field))throw Error(ui.t('Vælg et element.'));if(kind==='jump'&&!targetDeck().slides.some(s=>s.title===target))throw Error(ui.t('Målet skal findes i den valgte præsentation.'));if(kind==='open'&&!W.getTiddler(target))throw Error(ui.t('Måltiddleren findes ikke.'));if(['toggle','mark'].includes(kind)&&!fields.includes(target))throw Error(ui.t('Målet skal være et af layoutets elementnavne: ')+fields.join(', '));
   const title=personal(),actions=W.getTiddler(title+'/Actions');const value=kind==='none'?'':'<$action-sendmessage $message="tm-huwiki-slide-action" kind="'+kind+'" target="'+esc(target)+'" deck="'+esc(kind==='jump'?deckSelect.value:'')+'" color="'+esc(color)+'"/>';

'use strict';
exports.name='huwiki-slideshow-package';exports.platforms=['browser'];exports.after=['startup'];exports.synchronous=true;
exports.startup=function(){
 const W=$tw.wiki,TAG='HUWiki-Præsentation';
 const decode=s=>{const t=document.createElement('textarea');t.innerHTML=s;return t.value;};
 function attributes(text){const a=Object.create(null);String(text).replace(/([\w$-]+)\s*=\s*(?:"([^"]*)"|'([^']*)'|([^\s"'=<>`{}]+))/g,(_,k,v,w,u)=>{a[k]=decode(v==null?(w==null?u:w):v);return '';});return a;}
 function readDeck(title,wiki=W){const t=wiki.getTiddler(title);if(!t||!(t.fields.tags||[]).includes(TAG))throw Error(ui.t('Målpræsentationen findes ikke: ')+title);let d;try{d=JSON.parse(t.fields.text);}catch(e){throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldig præsentation: ')+title);}if(!d||!Array.isArray(d.slides))throw Error(ui.t('Ugyldig præsentation: ')+title);d=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(d));if(Array.isArray(t.fields.list))d.slides=t.fields.list.map(title=>d.slides.find(s=>s.title===title)||{title});return d;}
 function references(d,wiki=W){
  const result=[];
  function boardExists(title){const t=wiki.getTiddler(title);return !!(t&&(t.fields.tags||[]).includes('pasteup')&&wiki.getTiddler(title+'/Layout')&&wiki.getTiddler(title+'/Styles'));}
  for(const slide of d.slides||[]){
   const mode=slide.displayMode&&slide.displayMode!=='auto'?slide.displayMode:boardExists(slide.title)?'pasteup':slide.backgroundPasteUp?'background':d.defaultLayoutPasteUp?'layout':d.defaultBackgroundPasteUp?'background':'standard';
   const board=mode==='layout'?slide.layoutPasteUp||d.defaultLayoutPasteUp:mode==='background'?slide.backgroundPasteUp||d.defaultBackgroundPasteUp:['pasteup','element'].includes(mode)?slide.pasteUpTitle||(boardExists(slide.title)?slide.title:''):'';
   const add=(target,kind)=>{if(target)result.push({target,source:slide.title,kind});};add(slide.title,'slide');add(board,'aktivt PasteUp-layout');
   if(board){const root=wiki.getTiddler(board),layout=wiki.getTiddler(board+'/Layout'),b=slide.bindings||{},source=wiki.getTiddler(slide.title);const values=root?Object.keys(layout?layout.fields:root.fields).map(k=>root.fields[k]).filter(x=>typeof x==='string').join('\n'):'';
    const nativeSource=mode==='pasteup'&&root&&root.fields['huws-source']?wiki.getTiddler(root.fields['huws-source']):source;
    if(mode==='pasteup'&&root&&root.fields['huws-source'])add(root.fields['huws-source'],'indhold i PasteUp');
    if(/huwiki-slide-image|source=<<huwsImage>>|get\[image\]/.test(values))add(b.imageTitle||(root&&root.fields['huws-image'])||(nativeSource&&nativeSource.fields[b.imageField||'image']),'billede i aktivt layout');
    if(/get\[related\]/.test(values))add(nativeSource&&nativeSource.fields.related,'link fra design');
    if(/huwsSecondary/.test(values))add(b.secondaryTitle,'anden tiddler i aktivt layout');
   }
  }return result;
 }
 function collect(deck,entryTitle,options){return collectFrom(W,deck,entryTitle,options||{});}
 function collectFrom(W,deck,entryTitle,options){
  if(!entryTitle)throw Error(ui.t('Gem præsentationen før eksport.'));
  const decks=new Map([[entryTitle,JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(deck))]]),rows=new Map(),visited=new Set(),queue=[],warnings=new Set(),issues=[];let currentSource=entryTitle;
  function missing(target,kind,choices){if(!issues.some(x=>x.source===currentSource&&x.target===target&&x.kind===kind))issues.push({source:currentSource,target,kind:kind||"indhold",choices});}
  function add(t,owner){if(!t||/^(https?:|data:|blob:|#)/i.test(t))return;if(t.startsWith('$:/')){if(!/^\$:\/plugins\/huwiki\/pasteup\//.test(t))warnings.add('Systemreference: '+t);return;}queue.push([t,owner,currentSource]);}
  function addDeck(title){if(!W.getTiddler(title)){missing(title,ui.t("præsentation"));return;}if(!decks.has(title))decks.set(title,readDeck(title,W));add(title,title);}
  function deckRefs(d,owner){if(!d.slides.length||d.slides.length>150)throw Error(ui.t('Præsentationen er tom eller for stor: ')+owner);references(d,W).forEach(ref=>{currentSource=ref.source;add(ref.target,owner);});}

  addDeck(entryTitle);
  while(queue.length){const [title,owner,source]=queue.shift();currentSource=source;const key=JSON.stringify([title,owner,source]);if(visited.has(key))continue;visited.add(key);const t=W.getTiddler(title);if(!t){missing(title);continue;}currentSource=title;if(visited.size>6000||rows.size>=1500)throw Error(ui.t('Pakken er for stor. Brug komplet ZIP-backup.'));const f=t.getFieldStrings();
   if(title===entryTitle){f.text=JSON.stringify(deck);f.list=$tw.utils.stringifyList(deck.slides.map(s=>s.title));}
   rows.set(title,f);
   if(decks.has(title)){deckRefs(decks.get(title),title);continue;}
   else if((t.fields.tags||[]).includes(TAG)){addDeck(title);continue;}
   if(f['huw-design-styles'])add(f['huw-design-styles'],owner);
   if(options.followDesignFields)['huws-source','huws-image','image','related','design-layout','av-source','av-source-two','av-source-three'].forEach(field=>{if(typeof f[field]==='string'&&f[field])add(f[field],owner);});
   ['Layout','Styles','Actions'].forEach(s=>{if(W.getTiddler(title+'/'+s))add(title+'/'+s,owner);});
   if(W.getTiddlerTranscludes)W.getTiddlerTranscludes(title).forEach(x=>add(x,owner));
   if(W.getTiddlerLinks)W.getTiddlerLinks(title).forEach(x=>add(x,owner));
   Object.entries(f).forEach(([field,value])=>{if(typeof value!=='string')return;const nativeLayout=(t.fields.tags||[]).includes('HUWiki-Slideshow-Design');if(!nativeLayout&&/\{\{\{|<\$(?:list|macrocall)\b|<(?:script|iframe)\b|<\$button\b|<<[a-zA-Z]|<\$(?:image|transclude|link)\b[^>]*(?:=<<|=\{)/.test(value))warnings.add(ui.t('Dynamisk indhold kræver kontrol: ')+title);
    (value.match(/\[img\[[^\]]+\]\]/g)||[]).forEach(mark=>add(mark.slice(5,-2).split('|').pop(),owner));
    const tags=value.match(/<\$(?:transclude|image|link|action-sendmessage)\b[^>]*>/g)||[];
    tags.forEach(tag=>{const a=attributes(tag);if(tag.startsWith('<$action-sendmessage')){
      if(a.$message!=='tm-huwiki-slide-action'){warnings.add(ui.t('Specialhandling i ')+title);return;}
      if(a.kind==='open')add(a.target,owner);
      if(a.kind==='jump'){const destination=a.deck||owner;if(!decks.has(destination))addDeck(destination);const d=decks.get(destination);if(!d)return;if(!d.slides.some(s=>s.title===a.target)){missing(a.target,'slide i '+destination,d.slides.map(s=>s.title));return;}add(a.target,destination);}
    }else add(a.tiddler||a.source||a.to,owner);});
    if(/<\$action-(?!sendmessage\b)/.test(value))warnings.add(ui.t('Specialhandling i ')+title);
   });
  }
  if(issues.length&&!options.allowMissing){const x=issues[0];throw Error(ui.t('Pakken mangler indhold: ')+x.target+' (link fra '+x.source+')');}
  // Membership in other decks is local context, not an export dependency.
  // Keep tags only for decks actually included, and repair membership even if
  // the startup migration has not run yet.
  const deckTags=new Set(W.getTiddlersWithTag(TAG)||[]);
  if(options.membershipTags!==false)rows.forEach((row,title)=>{
   const tags=$tw.utils.parseStringArray(row.tags||'').filter(tag=>!deckTags.has(tag)||decks.has(tag));
   decks.forEach((d,tag)=>{if(d.slides.some(s=>s.title===title)&&!tags.includes(tag))tags.push(tag);});
   row.tags=$tw.utils.stringifyList(tags);
  });
  const data={package:{id:deck.packageId||entryTitle,title:deck.name,author:deck.author||'',version:deck.version||'1.0.0',description:deck.description||'',requires:['$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow','$:/plugins/huwiki/pasteup']},format:'huwiki-slideshow',schemaVersion:1,entryTitle,createdAt:new Date().toISOString(),deck:decks.get(entryTitle),tiddlers:Array.from(rows.values())};
  return {data,issues,warnings:Array.from(warnings),summary:{presentations:decks.size,slides:Array.from(decks.values()).reduce((n,d)=>n+d.slides.length,0),tiddlers:rows.size,images:data.tiddlers.filter(t=>/^image\//.test(t.type||'')).length}};
 }
 function describe(p){const s=p.summary;return s.presentations+ui.t(' præsentationer, ')+s.slides+' slides, '+s.images+' billeder og '+s.tiddlers+' tiddlere i alt.';}
 function review(deck,entryTitle){return new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
  const dialog=document.createElement('dialog');dialog.style.cssText='width:min(780px,94vw);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;padding:24px;border:1px solid #c7d7e8;border-radius:16px;font:16px system-ui;color:#203b59';let settled=false;
  function finish(pack){settled=true;dialog.close();dialog.remove();resolve(pack);}
  function cancel(){if(settled)return;settled=true;dialog.remove();reject(Error(ui.t('Eksport annulleret.')));
  }dialog.addEventListener('cancel',ev=>{ev.preventDefault();cancel();});
  function render(){dialog.textContent='';const heading=document.createElement('h2');heading.textContent=ui.t('Indhold der følger med');dialog.appendChild(heading);let pack;try{pack=collect(deck,entryTitle,{allowMissing:true});}catch(err){const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent=err.message;dialog.appendChild(p);const close=document.createElement('button');close.textContent=ui.t('Luk');close.onclick=cancel;dialog.appendChild(close);return;}
   const summary=document.createElement('p');summary.textContent=describe(pack);dialog.appendChild(summary);const note=document.createElement('p');note.textContent=ui.t('Linkmål og deres nødvendige indhold følger med i pakken. Almindelige links åbnes i et læsepanel. Præsentationens rækkefølge og wikiens tiddlere ændres ikke.');dialog.appendChild(note);
   for(const issue of pack.issues){const box=document.createElement('p');box.textContent='Fra »'+issue.source+'« → »'+issue.target+ui.t('«: det præcise mål findes ikke i denne wiki (')+issue.kind+ui.t('). Gendan eller importér originalen, og prøv igen. Eksporten erstatter ikke indhold.');dialog.appendChild(box);}
   const roots=new Set([entryTitle,...deck.slides.map(s=>s.title)]),extra=pack.data.tiddlers.filter(t=>!roots.has(t.title));const details=document.createElement('details'),cap=document.createElement('summary');cap.textContent=ui.t('Ekstra indhold: ')+extra.length+' tiddlere (vis liste)';details.appendChild(cap);const list=document.createElement('ul');extra.forEach(t=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=t.title;list.appendChild(li);});details.appendChild(list);dialog.appendChild(details);
   if(pack.warnings.length){const warning=document.createElement('p');warning.textContent=pack.warnings.join('\n');dialog.appendChild(warning);}
   const go=document.createElement('button');go.textContent=ui.t('Fortsæt med dette indhold');go.disabled=!!pack.issues.length;go.onclick=()=>finish(pack);dialog.appendChild(go);const close=document.createElement('button');close.textContent=ui.t('Annuller');close.onclick=cancel;dialog.appendChild(close);
  }render();document.body.appendChild(dialog);dialog.showModal();
 });}

 window.HUWikiSlideshowPackage={collect,collectFrom,review,describe,readDeck,attributes,references};
};

    if(!titles.length){
      layer.style.display="flex";renderDecks();
      message(mode==="story"?ui.t("StoryList indeholder ingen præsentérbare tiddlers."):ui.t("Dette tag indeholder ingen præsentérbare tiddlers."),true);
      return;
    }
    var title=mode==="story"?"StoryList":value;
    startPresent(normalize({name:title,theme:working&&working.theme||"night",source:source,
      slides:titles.map(function(t){return {title:t,notes:""};})}));
  }
  root.addEventListener("tm-huwiki-slideshow-present",function(ev){
    var mode=ev&&String(ev.param||"story");
    if(mode==="story")presentSource("story","");
    else if(mode.indexOf("tag:")===0)presentSource("tag",mode.slice(4));
    return false;
  });
  function editTiddlerPresentation(title,titles){
    if(!layer)build();if(!ensureSaved())return;
    selected=W.generateNewTitle("Præsentation – "+title);selectedSlide=-1;
    working=normalize({name:selected.replace(/^Præsentation – /,""),packageId:crypto.randomUUID(),source:{mode:"manual",value:""},slides:titles.map(function(t){return {title:t,notes:""};})});
    dirty=true;byId("create").hidden=true;layer.style.display="flex";switchTab("slides");renderDecks();renderDetails();markChanged();
    message(ui.t("Din egen præsentation er klar. Træk slides i den ønskede rækkefølge. Den oprindelige liste ændres ikke."));
  }
  function chooseTiddlerPresentation(title,listTitles){
    var old=document.getElementById("huws-source-choice");if(old)old.remove();
    var dialog=document.createElement("dialog");dialog.id="huws-source-choice";dialog.className="huws-source-choice";
    dialog.setAttribute("aria-labelledby","huws-source-choice-title");
    var heading=document.createElement("h2");heading.id="huws-source-choice-title";heading.textContent=ui.t("Hvad vil du præsentere?");dialog.appendChild(heading);
    var note=document.createElement("p");note.textContent=listTitles?ui.t("Brug listen fra »")+title+ui.t("« til en præsentation:"):ui.t("Der er ingen liste i »")+title+ui.t("«. Vælg indhold til slideshowet:");dialog.appendChild(note);
    var choices=document.createElement("div");choices.className="huws-source-choices";dialog.appendChild(choices);
    function add(label,titles){
      var row=document.createElement("div"),caption=document.createElement("p");row.className="huws-source-option";caption.textContent=label+" · "+titles.length+(titles.length===1?" slide":" slides");row.appendChild(caption);
      function action(label,run){var button=document.createElement("button");button.type="button";button.textContent=label;button.onclick=function(){dialog.close();dialog.remove();try{run();}catch(error){window.alert(error.message);}};row.appendChild(button);}
      action(ui.t("Vis nu"),function(){startPresent(normalize({name:title,slides:titles.map(function(t){return {title:t};})}),title);});
      action(ui.t("Åbn i editor"),function(){editTiddlerPresentation(title,titles);});choices.appendChild(row);
    }
    var seen=Object.create(null);
    function addTag(tag,own){if(!tag||seen[tag]||tag.indexOf("$:/")===0)return;seen[tag]=true;var titles=getSourceTitles({mode:"tag",value:tag});if(titles.length)add((own?ui.t("Tagget med tiddlerens titel: "):ui.t("Fra tag: "))+tag,titles);}
    if(listTitles)add(ui.t("Tiddlerens liste"),listTitles);
    else {addTag(title,true);(W.getTiddler(title).fields.tags||[]).forEach(function(tag){addTag(tag,false);});add(ui.t("Kun denne tiddler"),[title]);}
    var cancel=document.createElement("button");cancel.type="button";cancel.textContent=ui.t("Annuller");cancel.className="tc-btn-invisible";cancel.onclick=function(){dialog.close();};dialog.appendChild(cancel);
    dialog.addEventListener("close",function(){dialog.remove();});document.body.appendChild(dialog);dialog.showModal();
  }
  root.addEventListener("tm-huwiki-slideshow-view",function(ev){
    var title=String(ev.param||ev.tiddlerTitle||"");
    if(!W.getTiddler(title))return false;
    try{
      if((W.getTiddler(title).fields.tags||[]).indexOf(TAG)>=0){startPresent(load(title),title);return false;}
      titleCache=null;
      var source=require("$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/list-source.js").resolve(W,title,root);
      if(!source.hasList){chooseTiddlerPresentation(title);return false;}
      var titles=distinctTitles(source.titles);
      if(!titles.length){window.alert(ui.t("Listen indeholder ingen eksisterende tiddlere, der kan vises som slides."));return false;}
      chooseTiddlerPresentation(title,titles);
    }catch(error){window.alert(error.message);}return false;
  });
  root.addEventListener("tm-huwiki-slideshow-imported",function(ev){if(!layer)build();renderDecks();select(String(ev.param));switchTab("slides");message(ui.t("Præsentationen er importeret. Gem hele wikien med TiddlyWikis Gem-knap."));return false;});
  root.addEventListener("tm-huwiki-slideshow-open",function(ev){if(!layer)build();var param=ev&&String(ev.param||"");
    renderDecks();if(param&&W.tiddlerExists(param)){if(ensureSaved())select(param);}else if(!working){select(listDecks()[0]||"");}
    layer.style.display="flex";
    if(param==="drive"){switchTab("import");if(window.HUWikiSlideshowImport)window.HUWikiSlideshowImport.openDrive();}
    if(["tag","story","list","manual"].indexOf(param)>=0)openCreate(param);
    return false;});

  W.addEventListener("change",function(changes){if(!changes["$:/language"]||!layer)return;
    var creating=!byId("create").hidden,visible=layer.style.display,tab=activeTab,wasPresent=stage.style.display!=="none",inputs={};
    layer.querySelectorAll("input[id],textarea[id],select[id]").forEach(function(e){if(e.type!=="file"&&e.type!=="password")inputs[e.id]={value:e.value,checked:e.checked};});
    // Keep an in-progress document import (including its file and preview) intact.
    var importPanel=byId("pane-import");importPanel.remove();
    clearLive();uiEvents.abort();layer.remove();stage.remove();layer=null;stage=null;build();
    var newImport=byId("pane-import");if(window.HUWikiSlideshowImport)window.HUWikiSlideshowImport.mount(importPanel);newImport.replaceWith(importPanel);
    renderDecks();renderDetails();Object.keys(inputs).forEach(function(id){var e=document.getElementById(id);if(e&&e.type!=="file"){e.value=inputs[id].value;e.checked=inputs[id].checked;}});
    switchTab(tab);byId("create").hidden=!creating;layer.style.display=visible;if(wasPresent){stage.style.display="flex";stage.setAttribute("data-theme",presenting.theme);renderStage();}
  });
  repairDemoMetadata();
  repairSlideshowHome();
  upgradeSlideshowActions();
  installPresentationShortcut();
  installDeckTags();
  setupTagPillMenu();
};
})();"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/style.css":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/style.css","type":"text/css","tags":"$:/tags/Stylesheet","text":"

'use strict';
exports.name='huwiki-slideshow-examples';exports.platforms=['browser'];exports.after=['huwiki-slideshow-startup'];exports.synchronous=true;
exports.startup=function(){
 const W=$tw.wiki;
 // Upgrade only the exact stock landing page; keep user-authored variations.
 const home='HUWiki Slideshow – Start',stock=W.getTiddlerText('$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/examples/PreviousHome','');
 if(W.tiddlerExists(home)&&W.getTiddlerText(home)===stock){const info=W.getPluginInfo('$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow'),fresh=info&&info.tiddlers[home];if(fresh)W.addTiddler(new $tw.Tiddler(W.getTiddler(home),{text:fresh.text}));}
 $tw.rootWidget.addEventListener('hu-copy-slideshow-example',function(event){
  try{
   const P=window.HUWikiSlideshowPackage,source=event.param,original=W.getTiddler(source);
   if(!original||(original.fields.tags||[]).indexOf('Slideshow/Eksempler')<0)return false;
   const pack=P.collect(P.readDeck(source),source,{followDesignFields:true});const start=W.getTiddler(source+'/Start her');if(start)pack.data.tiddlers.push(start.getFieldStrings());const name=W.generateNewTitle('Min '+(original.fields.caption||ui.t('fortælling'))),map=new Map(),stamp=$tw.utils.stringifyDate(new Date());
   map.set(source,name);
   pack.data.tiddlers.forEach(row=>{if(row.title===source)return;map.set(row.title,row.title.startsWith(source+'/')?name+row.title.slice(source.length):name+'/Materialer/'+row.title);});
   // Longest first, in one pass, so a renamed title cannot be remapped twice.
   const escape=s=>s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,'\\$&'),pattern=new RegExp(Array.from(map.keys()).sort((a,b)=>b.length-a.length).map(escape).join('|'),'g');
   const rewrite=value=>typeof value==='string'?value.replace(pattern,m=>map.get(m)):Array.isArray(value)?value.map(rewrite):value;
   const rows=pack.data.tiddlers.map(row=>{
    const f={};Object.keys(row).forEach(k=>f[k]=rewrite(row[k]));f.created=stamp;f.modified=stamp;
    f.tags=$tw.utils.parseStringArray(f.tags||'').filter(t=>!t.startsWith('Slideshow/Eksempler')&&!t.startsWith('Slideshow/Tema/')&&!t.startsWith('Slideshow/Lær/')&&t!=='Slideshow/Eksempelindhold');
    if(row.title===source){const deck=JSON.parse(f.text);deck.name=name;deck.packageId=crypto.randomUUID();deck.author='';deck.version='1.0.0';deck.source={mode:'manual',value:''};f.text=JSON.stringify(deck);f.caption=name;f['example-origin']=source;delete f['example-order'];delete f['example-cover'];delete f['example-guide'];}
    return new $tw.Tiddler(f);
   });
   if(rows.some(t=>W.getTiddler(t.fields.title)))throw Error(ui.t('Navnet er allerede i brug. Prøv igen.'));
   W.addTiddlers(rows);new $tw.Story().navigateTiddler(name+'/Start her');
   $tw.rootWidget.dispatchEvent({type:'tm-huwiki-slideshow-open',param:name});
  }catch(e){$tw.utils.alert('Slidebibliotek',e.message||String(e));}
  return false;
 });
};

","type":"text/css","tags":["$:/tags/Stylesheet"],"huwiki-example-resource":"yes"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/documents.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/documents.js","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"startup","text":"var ui=require("$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/i18n.js");
'use strict';
exports.name='huwiki-slideshow-documents';exports.platforms=['browser'];exports.after=['startup'];exports.synchronous=true;
exports.startup=function(){
 const MAX=20*1024*1024;let connection=null;
 const esc=s=>String(s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&','<':'<','>':'>','"':'"',"'":'''}[c]));
 const xml=text=>{const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'application/xml');if(doc.querySelector('parsererror'))throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentets XML er beskadiget.'));return doc;};
 const all=(node,name)=>Array.from(node.getElementsByTagNameNS('*',name));
 const content=node=>all(node,'t').map(t=>t.textContent).join('');
 function split(name,blocks,options){
  const groups=[];let group=null;const mode=options.splitMode||'auto';
  for(const block of blocks){
   const begin=!group||block.heading||mode==='detailed'||(mode==='semantic'&&group.text.length>1200)||(mode==='auto'&&group.text.length>2200);
   if(begin){group={title:block.heading||name+' '+(groups.length+1),text:'',type:'text/html'};groups.push(group);}
   group.text+=block.html+'\n';
  }
  if(groups.length>150)throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentet har mere end 150 afsnit. Del kilden op.'));
  return groups.filter(g=>g.text.trim());
 }
 function cleanHtml(text){const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(text,'text/html');
  d.querySelectorAll('script,style,iframe,object,embed,link,meta,form,input,button,textarea,select,img,svg,video,audio,source').forEach(n=>n.remove());
  for(const el of d.body.querySelectorAll('*'))for(const a of Array.from(el.attributes)){if(a.name!=='href'||el.tagName!=='A'||!/^https?:\/\//i.test(a.value))el.removeAttribute(a.name);}
  return d.body;
 }
 async function prepare(file,options){
  if(file.size>MAX)throw Error(ui.t('Filen må højst være 20 MB.'));const ext=file.name.toLowerCase().split('.').pop();
  if(options.mode==='visual')return convert(file,options);
  if(['html','htm'].includes(ext)){
   const body=cleanHtml(await file.text());const blocks=Array.from(body.children).map(el=>({heading:/^H[1-6]$/.test(el.tagName)?el.textContent:'',html:el.outerHTML}));
   if(!blocks.length&&body.textContent.trim())blocks.push({html:'<p>'+esc(body.textContent)+'</p>'});
   return {kind:'sections',name:file.name,sections:split(file.name,blocks,options),warning:ui.t('Lokal tekstimport. Aktivt webindhold og billeder medtages ikke i teksttilstand.')};
  }
  if(!['docx','pptx','odt','odp'].includes(ext))return convert(file,options);
  await window.HUWikiSlideshowVendors.ensure(['jszip.js']);const Zip=require('$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/vendor/jszip.js');
  const zip=await Zip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());const entries=Object.values(zip.files);let size=0;
  for(const e of entries){size+=e._data?.uncompressedSize||0;if(size>150*1024*1024)throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentet bliver for stort efter udpakning.'));}
  const read=async name=>{const f=zip.file(name);if(!f)throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentet mangler ')+name);const s=await f.async('string');if(s.length>20*1024*1024)throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentets tekst er for stor.'));return xml(s);};
  let sections=[];
  if(ext==='docx'){
   const doc=await read('word/document.xml'),body=all(doc,'body')[0],blocks=[],links=new Map();
   if(zip.file('word/_rels/document.xml.rels'))for(const r of (await read('word/_rels/document.xml.rels')).documentElement.children){const target=r.getAttribute('Target');if(/^https?:\/\//i.test(target||''))links.set(r.getAttribute('Id'),target);}
   function inline(el){if(el.localName==='r'){let text=esc(content(el));if(all(el,'b').length)text='<strong>'+text+'</strong>';if(all(el,'i').length)text='<em>'+text+'</em>';return text;}const text=Array.from(el.children).map(inline).join('');const href=el.localName==='hyperlink'&&links.get(el.getAttribute('r:id'));return href?'<a href="'+esc(href)+'">'+text+'</a>':text;}
   for(const el of Array.from(body.children)){
    if(el.localName==='p'){
     const value=content(el);if(!value.trim())continue;const style=all(el,'pStyle')[0]?.getAttribute('w:val')||'';
     const heading=/heading|overskrift|title/i.test(style)?value:'';
     const runs=inline(el);
     const list=all(el,'numPr').length;blocks.push({heading,html:heading?'<h2>'+esc(value)+'</h2>':list?'<ul><li>'+runs+'</li></ul>':'<p>'+runs+'</p>'});
     if(list&&options.splitListItems)blocks.at(-1).heading=value.slice(0,100);
    }else if(el.localName==='tbl'){const rows=all(el,'tr').map(tr=>'<tr>'+Array.from(tr.children).filter(c=>c.localName==='tc').map(c=>'<td>'+esc(content(c))+'</td>').join('')+'</tr>');blocks.push({html:'<table>'+rows.join('')+'</table>'});}
   }
   sections=split(file.name,blocks,options);
  }else if(ext==='pptx'){
   // Follow presentation relationship order, not ZIP filename order.
   const presentation=await read('ppt/presentation.xml'),rels=await read('ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels');
   const relation=new Map(Array.from(rels.documentElement.children).filter(r=>r.getAttribute('TargetMode')!=='External').map(r=>[r.getAttribute('Id'),r.getAttribute('Target')]));
   for(const [i,id]of all(presentation,'sldId').entries()){
    const target=relation.get(id.getAttribute('r:id'));if(!target)throw Error(ui.t('Præsentationen mangler en slide-reference.'));
    const name=new URL(target,'https://zip.invalid/ppt/').pathname.slice(1);const doc=await read(name);
    const paragraphs=all(doc,'p').map(p=>content(p)).filter(t=>t.trim());sections.push({title:paragraphs[0]||'Slide '+(i+1),text:paragraphs.map(t=>'<p>'+esc(t)+'</p>').join('\n'),type:'text/html'});
   }
  }else{
   const doc=await read('content.xml');
   if(ext==='odp'){sections=all(doc,'page').map((page,i)=>{const paragraphs=all(page,'p').map(p=>p.textContent).filter(Boolean);return {title:paragraphs[0]||'Slide '+(i+1),text:paragraphs.map(t=>'<p>'+esc(t)+'</p>').join('\n'),type:'text/html'};});}
   else{const blocks=[];for(const el of all(doc,'text')[0]?.children||[]){if(el.localName==='h')blocks.push({heading:el.textContent,html:'<h2>'+esc(el.textContent)+'</h2>'});else if(el.localName==='p')blocks.push({html:'<p>'+esc(el.textContent)+'</p>'});else if(el.localName==='list'){for(const item of all(el,'list-item'))blocks.push({heading:options.splitListItems?item.textContent.slice(0,100):'',html:'<ul><li>'+esc(item.textContent)+'</li></ul>'});}else if(el.localName==='table'){blocks.push({html:'<table>'+all(el,'table-row').map(row=>'<tr>'+all(row,'table-cell').map(c=>'<td>'+esc(c.textContent)+'</td>').join('')+'</tr>').join('')+'</table>'});}}sections=split(file.name,blocks,options);}
  }
  if(sections.length>150)throw Error(ui.t('Dokumentet har mere end 150 afsnit. Del kilden op.'));
  return {kind:'sections',name:file.name,sections,warning:ui.t('Lokal tekstimport. Overskrifter, tekst og enkle lister/tabeller bevares; billeder, animationer og præcist layout kræver visuel import.')};
 }
 async function convert(file,options){
  if(!connection)throw Error(ui.t('Denne konvertering kræver den lokale LibreOffice-hjælper. Forbind den nedenfor, eller vælg en PDF eksporteret fra dit dokument.'));
  const bytes=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());let raw='';for(let i=0;i<bytes.length;i+=16384)raw+=String.fromCharCode.apply(null,bytes.subarray(i,i+16384));
  const r=await fetch(connection.url+'/convert',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json','Authorization':'Bearer '+connection.token},body:JSON.stringify({name:file.name,base64:btoa(raw),mode:options.mode})});
  if(!r.ok)throw Error((await r.json()).error||ui.t('Konvertering mislykkedes.'));const result=await r.json();result.warning=ui.t('Konverteret lokalt med LibreOffice. Kontrollér skrifter, layout og sideskift i forhåndsvisningen. Office-animationer og talernoter importeres ikke.');return result;
 }
 function mount(panel){const box=document.createElement('details');box.innerHTML=ui.t('<summary>Valgfri lokal dokumentkonvertering</summary><p>Brug LibreOffice på din egen computer til visuel Word/PowerPoint-import og ældre dokumentformater. Filerne sendes kun til den lokale hjælper. Forbindelsen huskes kun, mens wikien er åben.</p><p><a href="https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/main/tools/slideshow-converter" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Installér den lokale hjælper</a></p><label>Hjælperens adresse<input data-url value="http://127.0.0.1:4977"></label><label>Midlertidig adgangskode<input data-token type="password" autocomplete="off"></label><button data-connect>Forbind lokal hjælper</button> <button data-disconnect>Afbryd</button><p data-status role="status"></p>');
  const e=k=>box.querySelector('[data-'+k+']');e('connect').onclick=async()=>{try{const u=new URL(e('url').value);if(u.protocol!=='http:'||!['127.0.0.1','localhost','[::1]'].includes(u.hostname)||u.username||u.password||u.pathname!=='/'||u.search||u.hash)throw Error(ui.t('Brug hjælperens lokale http-adresse.'));const token=e('token').value;if(!token)throw Error(ui.t('Indsæt hjælperens midlertidige adgangskode.'));const r=await fetch(u.origin+'/health',{headers:{Authorization:'Bearer '+token}});if(!r.ok)throw Error(ui.t('Forbindelsen blev afvist.'));connection={url:u.origin,token};e('token').value='';e('status').textContent=ui.t('Lokal hjælper forbundet.');}catch(error){connection=null;e('status').textContent=error.message;}};e('disconnect').onclick=()=>{connection=null;e('token').value='';e('status').textContent=ui.t('Forbindelsen er afbrudt.');};panel.appendChild(box);if(connection)e('status').textContent=ui.t('Lokal hjælper forbundet.');
 }
 window.HUWikiSlideshowDocuments={prepare,mount};
};
"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/i18n.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/i18n.js","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"library","text":"'use strict';
var dictionary;
function load(){if(!dictionary)dictionary=JSON.parse($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText('$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/strings.json','{}'));}
function da(){return /^\$:\/languages\/da(?:-DK)?$/.test($tw.wiki.getTiddlerText('$:/language',''));}
function plain(text){return text.replace(/^(\s*)([\s\S]*?)(\s*)$/,function(_,a,key,b){return a+(dictionary[key]||key)+b;});}
// Only static source literals call this function. User content is concatenated afterwards.
exports.t=function(text){load();if(da())return text;if(dictionary[text.trim()])return plain(text);if(text.indexOf('<')<0)return text;return text.replace(/(?:^|>)([^<>]*)(?=<|$)/g,function(match,body){return match.slice(0,match.length-body.length)+plain(body);}).replace(/((?:title|aria-label|placeholder|emptyMessage)=["'])([^"']+)(["'])/g,function(_,a,b,c){return a+plain(b)+c;});};
exports.isDanish=da;
"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/strings.json":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/strings.json","type":"application/json","text":"{
  "Arbejder…": "Working…",

[[Oplev de syv fortællinger|HUWiki Slideshow – Start]], og lav din egen version. Værkstedet kan også begynde med enkelte tiddlere, et tag, åbne tiddlere eller en gemt titelliste.

* Slides beholder forbindelsen til deres tiddlere. Træk dem i rækkefølge og tilføj private talernoter.
* Design bruger det eksisterende PasteUp. Du kan ændre en hel præsentation eller enkelte slides.
* Import læser lokale dokumenter. PDF kan blive sidebilleder eller redigerbar tekst. DOCX/PPTX/ODT/ODP har lokale tekstlæsere; visuel Office-import kan bruge en valgfri [[lokal LibreOffice-hjælper|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/main/tools/slideshow-converter]].
* Eksport tilbyder PDF, redigerbar præsentationspakke, interaktivt HTML-site og backup af hele wikien. Indlejr eksterne medier først.
* Gem hele wikien med TiddlyWikis Gem-knap. Værkstedets automatiske gemning lægger ændringer i den åbne wiki, ikke automatisk på disken.

Dansk/engelsk vælges i TiddlyWikis kontrolpanel. Oprindelige eksempeltekster og dine egne tekster ændres ikke ved sprogskift.

Maksimum ved import: 20 MB og 150 slides/afsnit. Office-animationer og talernoter importeres ikke gennem PDF. Scannede PDF-sider kan vises som billeder; automatisk OCR følger ikke med. Desktop Chrome er afprøvet; mobil/touch er endnu ikke accepteret.

Originale kilder, ophav og vendorlicenser er bevaret. [[Kilder og begrænsninger|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/blob/main/docs/creative-editions.md]].
"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/Guide/en/$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/readme":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/Guide/en/$:/plugins/huwiki/slideshow/readme","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"! HUWiki Slideshow

[[Explore the seven stories|HUWiki Slideshow – Start]] and make your own version. The workshop can also start with individual tiddlers, a tag, open tiddlers or a saved title list.

* Slides stay connected to their tiddlers. Drag them into order and add private speaker notes.
* Design uses the existing PasteUp plugin. Change the whole presentation or individual slides.
* Import reads local documents. PDF can become page images or editable text. DOCX/PPTX/ODT/ODP have local text readers; visual Office import can use an optional [[local LibreOffice helper|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/tree/main/tools/slideshow-converter]].
* Export offers PDF, an editable presentation package, an interactive HTML site and a backup of the whole wiki. Embed external media first.
* Save the whole wiki with TiddlyWiki’s Save button. The workshop’s automatic save updates the open wiki; it does not automatically write to disk.

Select Danish/English in TiddlyWiki’s control panel. Original example text and your own content are not changed by switching language.

Import limit: 20 MB and 150 slides/sections. Office animations and speaker notes are not imported through PDF. Scanned PDF pages can be viewed as images; OCR is not included. Desktop Chrome has been tested; mobile/touch acceptance is pending.

Original sources, authors and vendor licenses are retained. [[Sources and limitations|https://github.com/maans/huwiki-forge/blob/main/docs/creative-editions.md]].
